verdict.rationale: Attio ships a native visual Workflows builder that workspace members use to define sequences of automated blocks. It supports record-event triggers such as "When a new deal is created", and steps such as enriching the record via a Web Agent and scoring and routing leads to the right rep or channel. Workflows can be extended with custom SDK triggers and steps that members configure without code. However, the evidence never explicitly shows built-in task-creation or notification-sending workflow actions; the SDK notification docs cover in-app user notifications from apps, not workflow steps. Missing for 10: documented native create-task workflow action, documented notification/alert workflow action, a full list of built-in triggers and record-update actions, independent or hands-on corroboration.
